choice_prompt:6:1711111004.text: As family, we hold nothing back! What do you want to ask? We'll tell you everything we know about the Emperor!
choice_prompt:6:1711111004.source_cn: 作为家人，我们绝不藏私！你想问什么？只要是关于大帝的情报，我们知无不言！

choice_prompt:9:1711111006.text: According to reports from the Guardian Council's spies throughout the city, there have been sightings of what appears to be the Emperor... cough, that noble fox, in three different locations recently.
choice_prompt:9:1711111006.source_cn: 据守护会潜伏在全城的眼线汇报，近期有三个地方出现了疑似大帝……咳，那只高贵狐狸的踪迹。

say:12:1711111009:1.text: Finally, there's the riverbank in the upper district, where people often see him lost in thought.
say:12:1711111009:1.source_cn: 最后是上城区的河道边，经常有人看到他在那里发呆。

say:14:1711111011:1.text: In short, Emperor Roland is elusive; whether you can meet him depends entirely on your luck.
say:14:1711111011:1.source_cn: 总之，罗兰大帝行踪如风，能不能见到他，全凭你的运气了。

choice:6:0:1.text: I want to see Emperor Roland.
